sloka: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी समाश्वस्तो महामनाः ।विप्रेक्षमाणो युद्धेप्सुः सरोषमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.७३ ।।।।
transliteration: hanumānapi tejasvī samāśvasto mahāmanāḥ ।viprekṣamāṇo yuddhepsuḥ saroṣamidamabravīt ।। 6.59.73 ।।।।

translations.english: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.
